overall: POOR to MARGINAL overall: two grounds GOOD (Tara, Decabobo), three MARGINAL (Coron, Galoc, Turda), five POOR and six VERY POOR, mostly the east side
limiterDetail: The main limiter is east wind: Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 22 kt (gusts 30), Ciron 22 kt, Barangonan 21 kt, Alava and Binudac 19 kt, Linapacan 17 kt, Maglalambay and Panlaitan 16 kt. For reference, 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad. Second limiter is current: 1.5–1.7 kt now at Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan (1.2 Culion and Binudac), with a strong pulse of 1.5–2.0 kt about midnight–5 AM Fri. Rain is not a factor (near 0 mm/h; about 1 mm on Sun 15).

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Wed 11, 2:20 PM)
items: Fishing got worse overnight: only two grounds are GOOD now (Tara, Decabobo). Fishing right now is 2 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 6 VERY POOR (was 3 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 4 VERY POOR). East wind came back up: Nangalao and Cabunlawan fell from POOR to VERY POOR (22 kt, gusts 30), Maglalambay and Panlaitan fell from MARGINAL to POOR (16 kt), and Turda slipped from GOOD to MARGINAL (10 kt wind, current 0.5 kt). Decabaitot, Alava, Ciron and Barangonan stay VERY POOR.

Regional wind: Thu 12 14 kt, gusts 20, Fri 13 13 kt, gusts 19, Sat 14 12 kt (was 11), Sun 15 7.5 kt, Mon 16 12 kt, gusts 19, Tue 17 9.4 kt, Wed 18 3.6 kt. Supply outlook is unchanged: Thu 12 and Fri 13 stay SOFT. Shortage detector ELEVATED Thu–Tue; surge OFF. PAGASA feed was unreachable again (SSL error); the CLEAR on the dashboard is only a default, not a confirmed check.

bestWindow.headline: Today about 10 AM–5 PM at Tara, Decabobo and Turda (wind 3–7 kt, current 0.1–0.5 kt); then Coron and Galoc about 4 PM–Fri 1 AM
details: Today and Fri 13 (13–14 kt, gusts 19–20) are the rough stretch , with supply thin Thu–Fri. Relief arrives Sun 15 (7.5 kt, gusts 12); Sat 14 is a partial easing (12 kt), Mon 16 rebuilds to 12 kt, then Tue 17 and Wed 18 improve.
